verdict.rationale: Sentry documents token-based credentials (Organization Tokens for sentry-cli). Its official MCP server, which agents use to connect, can be scoped to a specific organization or project, which limits what the agent can reach. The evidence does not describe permission scopes on the tokens themselves or a least-privilege credential flow built for agents. missing for 10: documented per-token permission scopes (read/write per resource), agent-specific credential issuance, token expiry and revocation controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: You can optionally scope the connection to an organization or project
Setting this up can be done either automatically, using sentry-cli, or manually via Organization Tokens.
When you return to the CLI, you'll paste in your token
